title: Futures redistribute cash flows through time
objectives: Build a daily variation-settlement and collateral ledger
Separate notional exposure, margin deposits and trading profit
Derive deterministic-rate forward/futures equivalence by a feasible strategy
Explain residual clearing and funding risks
prerequisites: Chapters 1–2 dated cash flows, compounding and statewise replication. Pricing-probability preview is clearly marked.
source_scope: Full English captions read sequentially for positions 6–8. Selected BIS PFMI and MIT forward/futures material inspected; no comprehensive audiovisual or current-exchange-rule audit.
